How to get your Groq API key
It\'s free, needs no credit card and takes about 2 minutes.
1. Tap “Open Groq page” (console.groq.com/keys) and sign in or create your account (with email or Google).
2. Tap “Create API Key”.
3. Give it a name (for example MusicFlame) and create it.
4. Copy it right then: Groq shows it only once and it starts with gsk_. Come back to MusicFlame, paste it into “Groq API key” and tap Save.
If you lose it, delete that key in Groq and create another. Never share your key.
Open Groq page
Online AI terms
What is it?

In online mode, the chat sends your messages to Groq (groq.com), a service that runs open AI models (OpenAI\'s GPT-OSS) on its servers and returns the answer. It uses YOUR own free Groq account and API key.
What leaves your phone

Your message, the latest chat messages, the name of the song that is playing and a short summary of songs from your library related to your question (title, artist, genre…). Your audio files, your Google account and other app data are not sent. MusicFlame has no server of its own and does not receive your conversations: they go straight from your phone to Groq. What Groq does with them is governed by its terms and privacy policy (links below). Don\'t type sensitive data.
Your API key
It is stored encrypted on this phone. It is not included in backups or in “Export settings”. It is personal: don\'t share or publish it.
Limits and errors

Groq\'s free plan has per-minute and per-day limits. The usage bar is an estimate from the app\'s own counter; Groq\'s count is the one that matters. If they run out, or there is no internet, MusicFlame can switch to the offline AI if you downloaded it. Like any AI, it can make mistakes or invent facts.
Model and license
GPT-OSS models (OpenAI), Apache-2.0 license, run by Groq. MusicFlame is not affiliated with Groq or OpenAI.
